$comment: Art and audio packs installed by `npm run assets:fetch`. The game is fully playable with
none of them: every animal, prop and level surface has procedural geometry, and every
sound is synthesised at runtime. Installing a pack is a visual/audio upgrade, never a
gameplay change — colliders, grips, hitboxes and every movement constant come from level
and player data, so a mesh swap cannot alter balance.
LICENCE RULE FOR THIS PROJECT: the game is web-delivered, so every file the server sends
is downloadable by any player with devtools open. That makes 'can end users extract the
raw assets?' a licence question we cannot answer with 'no'. Unity Asset Store, Synty and
Fab-Standard EULAs all restrict exactly that, so those sources are refused by the fetch
script rather than left to a reviewer to catch. Only CC0, CC-BY and permissive software
Packs behind a click-through cannot be fetched by URL. Declare them with "source":
"manual", download the archive by hand, and run:

packs.title: Fox (glTF sample asset)
packs.author: PixelMannen; rigging & animation by tomkranis; glTF conversion by @AsoboStudio and @scurest
packs.note: Model is CC0-1.0; the rigging, animation and glTF conversion are CC-BY-4.0, so the pack as shipped requires attribution. Ships with Survey/Walk/Run cycles.

packs.title: Ultimate Animated Animals
packs.author: Quaternius
packs.note: 12+ rigged animals with 12+ animations each (walk, run, jump, idle, attack), in glTF. The single best fit for the launch roster: CC0, so it can ship in a web build with no attribution obligation, and already animated.

packs.title: Universal Animation Library
packs.author: Quaternius
packs.note: Retargetable humanoid animation set. Useful for the emote system and for VR avatar upper-body poses; the locomotion itself is driven by the simulation, not by animation clips.

packs.title: Stylised Nature / Jungle kit
packs.author: Quaternius
packs.note: Trees, rocks and foliage for the decorative props layer only. LevelDef.props is a separate list from LevelDef.colliders precisely so decoration can never change where a surface can be climbed.

packs.title: Nature Kit
packs.author: Kenney
packs.note: Alternative environment kit in a cleaner, flatter style. Pick this OR the Quaternius nature kit — mixing two art directions in one level looks worse than either alone.

packs.title: Impact Sounds
packs.author: Kenney
packs.note: Optional replacement for the procedural landing/punch/tag sounds. The synthesised audio is deliberate — it keeps the first load small, which matters on mobile data and on a Quest launching straight into WebXR — so treat sample audio as an upgrade to evaluate against that cost, not a default.
